# ProjectStore.pk

> Pakistan's premium DIY store where we sell complete DIY kits, hardware components, and software codes for all — engineering students, developers, makers, and innovators.

ProjectStore.pk is a premium DIY electronics store and engineering prototyping platform based in Lahore, Pakistan. We provide complete ready-to-build DIY kits, verified hardware components, sensors, microcontrollers (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi), and complete software source codes with circuit schematics and documentation for all skill levels.

## Key Facts & Specifications
- **Name**: ProjectStore.pk
- **Headquarters**: 2nd Floor, 72, Westend Plaza, Shahrah-e-Quaid-e-Azam, Mozang Chungi, Lahore, 54000, Pakistan
- **Parent Network**: ISOL (https://isol.pk)
- **Nationwide Coverage**: Fast 24-48h dispatch to Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, and 250+ cities across Pakistan.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), Online Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, JazzCash.
- **Product Guarantee**: 100% authentic, pre-tested components with a 7-day replacement warranty.
- **Currency**: Pakistani Rupee (PKR).

## Core Product Categories & Direct Links
- [All Products & Hardware Catalog](https://projectstore.pk/product/): Browse full catalog of electronic components, DIY kits, and sensors.
- [Custom 3D Printing & Rapid Prototyping](https://projectstore.pk/3d-printing-service/): Professional 3D printing services in PLA+, PETG, ABS, TPU, and Resin for electronics enclosures and engineering FYPs.
- [3D Printed Parts & Enclosures](https://projectstore.pk/category/3d-printed-parts/): Precision 3D printed sensor brackets, ESP32-CAM cases, and Arduino bumper enclosures.
- [Project Guides & DIY Tutorials](https://projectstore.pk/blog/): In-depth engineering tutorials, ESP32/Arduino wiring guides, and top Final Year Project (FYP) architectures with verified source code.
- [Final Year Student Projects (FYP)](https://projectstore.pk/project/): Complete engineering and AI projects with working hardware, circuit diagrams, and source code.
- [Return & Refund Policy](https://projectstore.pk/return-policy/): 7-day free replacement guarantee details.
- [Electronic Categories](https://projectstore.pk/category/): Categorized index of components and accessories.
- [Direct Contact & Engineering Support](https://projectstore.pk/contact/): Technical inquiries, custom PCB fabrication, and component sourcing.
- [XML Sitemap](https://projectstore.pk/sitemap.xml): Full machine-readable URL index for web crawlers.
